checks.describe: pytest passes inside the checkpoint -- 15 tests: 8 carried from v0.2, 3 from Phase A, 4 from Phase B's constraints and to_summary

checks.describe: the demo entry point prints an OK line for the good example
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.3 && uv run python -m platformops.servicedef | grep -c 'OK -- checkout-api'

checks.describe: the demo entry point prints a FAIL line for the bad example
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.3 && uv run python -m platformops.servicedef | grep -c 'FAIL --'

checks.describe: GOOD_EXAMPLE validates into a real ServiceDefinition instance
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE, ServiceDefinition; r = validate_service(GOOD_EXAMPLE); assert isinstance(r, ServiceDefinition); print('OK')"

checks.describe: a service definition missing a required field fails validation with a structured 'missing' error
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; data = {k: v for k, v in GOOD_EXAMPLE.items() if k != 'deployment_name'}; errors = validate_service(data); assert isinstance(errors, list); assert any(e['loc'] == ('deployment_name',) and e['type'] == 'missing' for e in errors); print('OK')"

checks.describe: a wrong-type value (int where str is declared) fails validation instead of being silently accepted
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; data = {**GOOD_EXAMPLE, 'aws_account': 111122223333}; errors = validate_service(data); assert isinstance(errors, list); assert any(e['loc'] == ('aws_account',) and e['type'] == 'string_type' for e in errors); print('OK')"

checks.describe: Phase B constraint: an environment outside dev/staging/prod is rejected
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; bad = {**GOOD_EXAMPLE, 'environment': 'production'}; errors = validate_service(bad); assert isinstance(errors, list); assert any(e['loc'] == ('environment',) for e in errors); print('OK')"

checks.describe: Phase B constraint: a region outside the allowed list is rejected
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; bad = {**GOOD_EXAMPLE, 'region': 'ap-northeast-9'}; errors = validate_service(bad); assert isinstance(errors, list); assert any(e['loc'] == ('region',) for e in errors); print('OK')"

checks.describe: Phase B constraint: a kubernetes_namespace that is not lowercase-DNS-safe is rejected
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; bad = {**GOOD_EXAMPLE, 'kubernetes_namespace': 'Checkout_API'}; errors = validate_service(bad); assert isinstance(errors, list); assert any(e['loc'] == ('kubernetes_namespace',) for e in errors); print('OK')"

checks.describe: Phase B: to_summary() returns a one-line string carrying the service name and owner
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.servicedef import validate_service, GOOD_EXAMPLE; svc = validate_service(GOOD_EXAMPLE); s = svc.to_summary(); assert 'checkout-api' in s and 'payments-team' in s; print('OK')"

checks.describe: the v0.2 inventory package is still intact and its tests still pass -- this module's work is additive, not a rewrite of prior modules
checks.run: uv run --directory labs/checkpoints/v0.3 python -c "from platformops.inventory import INVENTORY, find_missing_owner; assert sorted(find_missing_owner(INVENTORY)) == ['web-02', 'worker-01']; print('OK')"
